data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2014 is reported as GBP 59.82m (Balance Sheet). The financial statements do not provide an explicit gross "movement in prior years' provision for claims outstanding" figure or a gross claims development triangle that isolates prior-year development (older than the two most recent underwriting years). The notes show aggregate movements in gross claims outstanding for the year (which combine current-year and prior-year movements) and the profit & loss contains a line "Claims incurred - development of prior accident years" but that P&L measure is an incurred charge, not a standalone movement in the prior years' reserves; therefore a clear, authoritative gross prior-year reserve movement cannot be determined from the available disclosures.
raw_causal_phrases: The syndicate has loss reserves for various events and for losses that are incurred but not reported (IBNR). Losses continue to develop both positively and negatively on these open balances. Whilst the syndicate has a reasonable degree of confidence as to the ultimate adequacy of its recourse for all events, volatility exists around the final settlement value.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Liabilities: Claims outstanding). No explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' (Insurance liabilities column) is provided in the notes; the notes include an overall 'Change in claims outstanding' (gross) which mixes current-year and prior-year movements and a P&L line 'Claims incurred - development of prior accident years' which is an incurred amount and explicitly excluded by the extraction rules. No gross claims development triangle is present. Therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m could not be determined from the available disclosures.
